'''Peter Fiekowsky''' is an American physicist, author and founder of the field of [[climate restoration]] and author of ''Climate Restoration: The Only Future That Will Sustain the Human Race'' (Rivertown Books, 2022, {{ISBN | 978-1953943101}}). He has founded or co-founded several organizations committed to restoring pre-industrial {{CO2}} levels by 2050. They include the Foundation for Climate Restoration, Methane Action, the Climate Restoration Safety and Governance Board, the Climate Restoration Fund, the Climate Restoration Alliance and the Climate Restoration Program.

== Early life and education ==
Fiekowsky holds a bachelor's degree in physics with a focus on infrared astrophysics from the [[Massachusetts Institute of Technology]] (MIT).<ref>{{Cite web|title=In Conversation with Peter Fiekowsky, Author of Climate Restoration|url=https://earth.org/interviews/peter-fiekowsky/|access-date=2024-07-28|website=Earth.Org}}</ref>

==Career==
After graduating from MIT, Fiekowsky worked at the NASA [[Kuiper Airborne Observatory]] in Mountain View, California, and later at the Fairchild/Schlumberger Artificial Intelligence Lab in Palo Alto. In 1984, he founded Automated Visual Inspection LLC, a machine vision company. He holds 27 patents related to machine vision technology.<ref>{{Cite patent|number=US7472372B1|title=Fast image simulation for photolithography|gdate=2008-12-30|invent1=Fiekowsky|invent2=Schuster|inventor1-first=Peter J.|inventor2-first=Richard E.|url=https://patents.google.com/patent/US7472372B1/en?inventor=peter+fiekowsky&oq=peter+fiekowsky&sort=new}}</ref>

== Activism and social entrepreneurship==
For three decades, Fiekowsky led citizen advocacy groups in the California chapters of [[Results (organization)|Results]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=November 2015 Global Webinar/Call: Global Fund Replenishment |url=https://results.org/wp-content/uploads/november_2015_global_national_grassroots_webinar_slides-reduced.pdf |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240518014449/https://results.org/wp-content/uploads/November_2015_Global_National_Grassroots_Webinar_Slides-reduced.pdf |archive-date=May 18, 2024 |access-date=2025-03-09 |website=results.org }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Oehser |first=Susan |date=2009-07-10 |title=My Word: Volunteers make world a better place |url=https://www.eastbaytimes.com/2009/07/10/my-word-volunteers-make-world-a-better-place/ |access-date=2025-03-09 |website=[[East Bay Times]]}}</ref> Fiekowsky led fundraising efforts and served as regional coordinator before taking a less active role in the 2010s.

===Restoring the pre-industrial climate===
In the first decade of the millennium, to assuage personal concerns about global warming, Fiekowsky began to research how humanity could restore the pre-industrial climate. In 2007, he helped establish the Citizens Climate Lobby (CCL) and was involved in designing a carbon tax study for the organization in 2012.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Environmental Tax Reform In California: Economic And Climate Impact Of A Carbon Tax Swap |url=https://citizensclimatelobby.org/wp-content/uploads/2014/03/REMI-CA-Carbon-Tax.pdf }}</ref> He also established CCL's "100-Year Plan" group in 2013. In the ensuing several years he developed his thesis that this historically safe climate,<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-04-09 |title=Climate Change: Atmospheric Carbon Dioxide |url=https://www.climate.gov/news-features/understanding-climate/climate-change-atmospheric-carbon-dioxide |archive-url=https://archive.today/20190318011302/https://www.climate.gov/news-features/understanding-climate/climate-change-atmospheric-carbon-dioxide |url-status=dead |archive-date=March 18, 2019 |access-date=2025-03-09 |website=[[National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration]]}}</ref> with [[Carbon dioxide|{{CO2}}]] levels around 280 parts per million (ppm) requires removing by 2050 the one to two trillion tons of additional {{CO2}} released into the atmosphere since the [[Industrial Revolution]] began.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Today |first=UMaine |date=2022-08-10 |title=Fiekowsky to discuss 'Climate Restoration' book on Aug. 15 |publisher=University of Maine |url=https://umaine.edu/news/blog/2022/08/10/fiekowsky-to-discuss-climate-restoration-book-on-aug-15/ |access-date=2023-10-19 |website=UMaine News}}</ref>

=== ''Climate Restoration: The Only Future That Will Sustain the Human Race'' ===
In his first book<ref>{{Cite web |title=Peter Fiekowsky {{!}} C-SPAN.org |url=https://www.c-span.org/person/?137222/PeterFiekowsky |access-date=2023-10-04 |website=[[C-SPAN]]}}</ref> Fiekowsky argues that [[Net-zero emissions|net-zero]] alone by 2050 would lead to atmospheric {{CO2}} levels over 450 ppm, 50 percent higher than human beings have survived on a long-term basis during all of our evolution and development. Net-zero represents the United Nations goal from 1990,<ref>{{Cite book |url=https://unfccc.int/resource/docs/publications/08_unfccc_kp_ref_manual.pdf |title=United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change Kyoto Protocol Reference Manual |date=November 2008 |publisher=United Nations |pages=55}}</ref> and is no longer sufficient to safeguard the future. Fiekowsky's current ambition is for climate activists and policymakers at all levels to expand climate goals to include both net-zero and [[climate restoration]]. This would require removing 60 gigatons of {{CO2}} a year and thus 1000 gigatons in 20 years (including drawing down continuing emissions).

=== Continued activism ===
In 2023, Fiekowsky published a paper<ref>{{Cite web |last=Fiekowsky |first=Peter |date=2023-10-12 |title=The Cost-Effectiveness of Carbon Dioxide Removal Methods |url=https://mahb.stanford.edu/blog/the-cost-effectiveness-of-carbon-dioxide-removal-methods/ |access-date=2025-03-10 |website=MAHB}}</ref> which finds that [[Direct air capture|direct-air capture]] (DAC) and other industrial [[carbon dioxide removal]] (CDR) methods are too costly to scale. According to his research, the solutions likely to reach climate-restoration scale swiftly and inexpensively are based on [[Biomimetics|biomimicry]]: they replicate and accelerate natural {{CO2}}-removal processes. These include [[ocean iron fertilization]]; [[atmospheric methane removal]]; and synthetic limestone. Implementing climate-restoration solutions immediately, Fiekowsky estimates, would pull enough {{CO2}} from the air in the next few years to enable the world to reach net-zero by 2030. From there, continued implementation could restore pre-industrial {{CO2}} levels by 2050.

===Organizations===
Fiekowsky has established or fostered a number of organizations to help achieve climate restoration, including the Foundation for Climate Restoration (F4CR, est. 2017) which has a mission to make climate restoration an idea whose time has come, and has been instrumental in starting discussions at the Vatican and the United Nations for making climate restoration a goal.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Climate Restoration made its debut at the United Nations |url=https://qz.com/1710975/climate-restoration-made-its-debut-at-the-united-nations/ |access-date=2023-12-29 |website=[[Quartz (publication)|Quartz]]}}</ref>
